scripts.web: cd .. && python3 build.py && mkdir -p native-app/www && cp release/Life-OS.html native-app/www/index.html
scripts.setup:ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.setup:android: npm run web && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs all
